title: Lower entropy thresholds for the unchanged tuned maps

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. Declaration: {"convention":"uniform-np-full-b2-actual-length-all-lengths-v1","family":"F_N=family.evaluate on all N actual bits; total uniform P program: family.py; fixed empty-witness NP verifier: proof.md. d_N is the unchanged minimum original geometry dimension, with fallback output0,d_N=N+1.","guarantee":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"polynomial_log","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}},"projection":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"finite"},"theorem":"At acceptance define the exact public response entropy Theta_j=T(response tuple) and block entropy Hsrc_j=(BLOCK) as in extractors.md; both are<=the tuning K_j and give the SAME maps/errors. Use these thresholds in proof.md (POS),(POS2) and exact active-pair (DP); t_N=beta(root)+1, otherwise t_N=N+1. beta(root) is the maximum affine dimension avoiding these prescribed pairs, without a monochromaticity claim. The full B2 bound C_B2(F_N)>=4N-8t_N+8 holds for EVERY integer N>=0. At acceptance t_N<=s_N<d_N, where s_N is the identical recipe at Theta_j=Hsrc_j=K_j. All thresholds are uniformly computable in polynomial time from N. At EVERY sufficiently large integer length, d_N<=2^ceil(DZ), D=8818127579/2000000000, Z=ceil(L^(3/4))*ceil(B^(1/4)), L=ceil(log2 N), B=ceil(log2(L+1)). Also limsup log2(d_N)/Z<=Cstar6<=440906378851/100000000000, where Cstar6=inf_(S6)(w0+X) and S6 is explicitly defined in proof.md. For each fixed real epsilon>0, C_B2(F_N)>=4N-N^epsilon at ALL sufficiently large integer N; this SAME family has liminf C_B2(F_N)/N>=4. ","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v1"}
